summary: Market tone is modestly risk-on but mixed: Bitcoin is holding just below $60,000 while major crypto assets show small gains, and US technology equities ended the week strongly higher. Gold rebounded sharply from recent lows, while oil and several smaller crypto tokens show higher volatility; direct same-day commentary from the named analysts could not be verified from the available results.
